description: This file defines functions and types for managing and evaluating access control policies for Telegram groups within the openclaw plugin SDK, including group override authorization, policy resolution, and allowlist enforcement.

methods.name: isGroupAllowOverrideAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the sender is authorized to override group permissions based on the effective allow list and sender information.

methods.name: evaluateTelegramGroupBaseAccess
methods.description: Evaluates whether a Telegram group or direct message access is permitted based on configuration, override status, and sender authorization.

methods.name: resolveTelegramRuntimeGroupPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the effective group policy for a Telegram account, considering provider configuration and defaults.

methods.name: evaluateTelegramGroupPolicyAccess
methods.description: Determines if a Telegram group or chat complies with the configured group policy, including allowlist checks and chat-level restrictions.
